title: The Gods of the Week
label: ch:ge-wochentage
canDo: I can name the five German weekdays, say which god is in each, and explain why one of them has no god at all.

payoff.summary: The Romans named their weekdays for planet-gods and the Germanic peoples swapped in their own, one for one, which is why German and English line up here and Romance does not. Five days are a god's name plus Tag; this chapter meets them one at a time, with the nouns Mond and Donner taught before the days built on them, and ends on Mittwoch — the day the medieval Church took Wodan out of.
payoff.note: Chapter 10 is generated from schema-v2 lessons, so the payoff is atom-scored. It introduces 11 atoms, under the maxNewAtomsPerChapter of 12: the seven weekdays were split across two chapters at the .tex's own weekday/weekend seam, because eighteen atoms in one chapter is a cram.
